role: evaluator only, six registered authored families. Development and training require their recorded H permission. Both confirmation families require the common all-case prediction opening before any target geometry is read or generated.
sources: Each family uses the actual archived source-generation mesh implementation, native calibrated world in metres and the cameras from its sealed R128 deployment scene. Source columns follow r000..r127. The independently fitted R16 uses its registered subset r000,r008,...,r120. The gate verifies the selected bank and its own R receipt.

sample_centres.order: row-major (y then x); all 1944 positions per h00..h05 per family, independent of source choices, predicted scores or error labels

target_surface: A double-precision, two-sided ray/triangle test in original world metres with no triangle culling returns the nearest hit at optical camera-Z of at least 0.05 m. Missing target intersections remain explicit background and are excluded from the foreground denominator.
true_source_visibility: For a target hit, project its exact 3-D position into each registered source using that source's real K/c2w. Require positive optical Z at or beyond the 0.05 m near plane and continuous integer-centre footprint -0.5 <= x < 377.5, -0.5 <= y < 251.5. Test the segment from the source camera centre to that same 3-D point for any nearer triangle between the source near plane and (point distance minus 0.000001 m). A segment free of intervening triangles counts as visible. Source coordinates are never rounded to depth pixels. Rays are normalized in world metres.
independent_controls: A nearer full-width parallel triangle in front of a far target blocks it, identical endpoint/coplanar triangles do not count as a nearer occluder, and a near/far separation below the old dense 1%-Z tolerance still blocks. Each production source camera will be tested for a deterministic subset against direct exhaustive source rays, independent of its BVH.
report: Per view include sample XY, target foreground, true target world position and optical Z, in-frustum and visible bool masks for all actual source IDs, input SHA and independent control results. On a real Q, take logical OR over its explicit source IDs. Report model comparable/true visibility confusion on the foreground probes. Dense nearest-pixel sampled-Z tolerance results are a separate approximation.
external_scenes: No true ETH3D visibility computation and no scan, point or depth readers.
